title: Do Honeypots Leak? Measuring Synthetic-Context Detectability for Open Models

original_idea.body: Construct graded-realism honeypot scenarios, ask several open models 'real deployment or test?', and measure detectability vs realism plus which surface features trigger suspicion.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying honeypot detectability addresses the core failure mode of a named control protocol.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Graded-realism scenario bank plus real-or-test ratings; prompt-only, highly accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped detectability-vs-realism measurement plus tell-tale-feature taxonomy.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Honeypot design is neglected, lab-independent infrastructure.

novelty.reasoning: Honeypot detectability active 2026 topic (overlaps gen-2685/2697 here); open-model quantification may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Honeypot detectability actively studied; open-model graded quantification may be partly open.
